powers_and_responsibilities: Scrutinize and approve academic regulations, curricula, and syllabi proposed by Boards of Studies.
Prescribe admission criteria in accordance with Government guidelines.
Recommend institution of new degree programs to the Governing Body.
Advise the Governing Body on all academic matters.

governing_body.name: Governing Body
governing_body.role: Apex governing authority determining strategic direction, financial budgets, infrastructure expansion, and statutory compliances of the institute.

board_of_studies.name: Board of Studies (BoS)
board_of_studies.role: Constituted for each academic department comprising subject matter experts, university nominees, industry practitioners, and faculty members to formulate dynamic, industry-relevant curriculum.

internal_quality_assurance_cell.name: Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
internal_quality_assurance_cell.role: Develops mechanisms and measures for continuous academic, research, and administrative quality improvement across all institute verticals.

anti_ragging_committee.name: Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad
anti_ragging_committee.role: Enforces strict Zero Tolerance policy against ragging in accordance with Supreme Court and AICTE mandates. Undertakes regular campus vigilance to ensure a secure environment.

internal_complaint_committee.name: Internal Complaint Committee (ICC / Women Development Cell)
internal_complaint_committee.role: Formed as per the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act (POSH Act) to prevent gender harassment and ensure a dignified, safe workplace for female students, staff, and faculty.

student_grievance_redressal_cell.name: Student Grievance Redressal Cell (SGRC)
student_grievance_redressal_cell.role: Addresses student grievances regarding examinations, admissions, facilities, or campus life in an impartial, prompt, and transparent manner.

committee_for_sc_st.name: Committee for SC / ST
committee_for_sc_st.role: Monitors implementation of affirmative reservation policies, resolves issues faced by SC/ST students and staff, and assists in scholarship execution.
